request.prompt: Extract the product name and manufacturer from this front-of-package photo, following the instructions in the system prompt.
request.system_prompt: You extract a small set of fields from a front-of-package product photo for a deterministic comparison task. Return a JSON object with two keys: `"product_name"` (the full product name as it appears on the front panel, including flavor / variant / count if printed there, lower-cased, single-spaced); and `"manufacturer"` (the manufacturer / brand owner exactly as printed, lower-cased; empty string if no manufacturer name is visible). Return JSON only, no prose.

response.text: {"product_name": "k-right vitamin k-complex k1 + mk-4 + mk-7 + d3 60 softgels", "manufacturer": "jarrow formulas"}
